name: Michigan
description: Build four suit sequences outward from 7. On your turn, play a card one rank above or below its suit sequence; if you cannot play, pass. First to empty their hand wins.
rules: Build four suit sequences outward from 7. On your turn, play a card one rank above or below its suit sequence; if you cannot play, pass. First to empty their hand wins.
ui_instructions: Play a highlighted legal card from your hand. The center rows show the ranks already built for each suit; pass only when no card is playable.
